These define different tests: with n=1, mu_0=0, sigma=2 and alpha=2(1-Phi(1)), the raw-coordinate indicator has null rejection probability 2(1-Phi(1/2))>alpha. Thus the subsequent standardized-tail calculations were not connected to that indicator. Repaired step 1.1 by defining T, its exact Borel preimage R, the measurable indicator phi=1_R, and phi(sample mean)=1_{|Z_n|>c_alpha}; the statement is unchanged.
